## Data Profile SQL

```sql
WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "monthly_rev._count",
  COUNT(DISTINCT monthly_rev.order_date) AS "monthly_rev.order_date_count_distinct",
  CAST(AVG(monthly_rev.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "monthly_rev.rev_avg"
FROM monthly_rev AS monthly_rev
LIMIT 3
```

args.message: I can't break monthly_rev down by day. The summary only has one row per month: its order_date is already cut to the start of each month and rev is the month's total. There's no daily detail left in it, and SLayer rejects a daily breakdown of this column for that reason. To get January 2025 revenue by day, the totals would have to come from the underlying orders data (sum of amount by order_date per day) instead of the monthly summary.
